about: Every trained model the app loads (PLAN.md 5.1). Each lists its trained files, which its card (ml/cards/<id>.json, docs/model-cards/<id>.md) records by hash; tests/test_model_cards.py fails when a file here is not registered, a registered file is missing, or a card is not what its files give. Train with the command shown (GitHub Actions: ml.yml); evaluate with python -m ml.evaluation evaluate.
